newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal 3-yr bond sale seen in line with market.
newsitem.headline: Portugal 3-yr bond sale seen in line with market.

text.p: Yields at the Portuguese Treasury's auction on Tuesday of three-year bonds (OT) were expected to be between 7.50 and 7.57 percent, in line with the secondary market, analysts and traders said.
The Treasury was expected to place the full 20 billion escudos of the March 1999 paper on offer.
"Despite the low level of liquidity in the market, there is sufficient demand for an auction slightly above 7.50 percent," said one trader.
Results of the auction are due around 1000 GMT.
At the last such sale on August 6, the Treasury placed 20 billion escudos of the OTs at an average yield of 7.6294 percent. The maximum was 7.64 percent and the minimum 7.59.
The 3-year OT closed on Friday at 7.52 percent. It did not trade on Monday.
